This data set contains twenty-one (21) scans of the Northern Whaling and Trading Company Shed, Herschel Island. All data was captured by the Capture2Presev team.  Fifteen (15) scans were collected on the exterior and six (6) scans of the interior with the Leica BLK 360 on the 16th August, 2019 and registered with AutoDesk ReCap Mobile and Pro V.6.1.
